chunks: 7 - Our father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated to us, he said: al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq an-Nahdi narrated to us, from his father, he said: Yazid ibn Makhlad an-Naysaburi narrated to me, he said: someone who heard al-Sadiq Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) narrated to me

He said: Friendship has conditions, so whoever does not have those conditions in him, do not attribute to him the perfection of friendship, and whoever does not have anything of those conditions in him, do not attribute to him any part of friendship. The first of them: that his inner self and his outward be one and the same for you. And the second: that he sees your adornment as his adornment, and your disgrace as his disgrace. And the third: that neither wealth nor authority changes him toward you. And the fourth: that he does not withhold from you anything that is within his ability. And the fifth: that he does not abandon you in times of calamities.
ai.seo_question: What are the five conditions of true friendship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) defines the five essential conditions of true friendship: sincerity in private and public, sharing honor and disgrace, constancy regardless of wealth or power, generosity within one's means, and loyalty in times of calamity.
